top_offers.title: Founding Engineer
top_offers.why: A founding engineer seat at a newly funded voice-AI startup from a well-known consumer-tech founder, this is the closest match to the build-from-zero cofounder experience at Alaya, with AI squarely at the product's core and remote flexibility that works from Geneva.

top_offers.title: VP Engineering (CTO-Track) – AI-Driven Video AdTech
top_offers.why: VP Engineering with an explicit CTO track and Switzerland eligibility fits the founding-background and leadership trajectory well, and the AI-adoption mandate plays to recent AI-augmented engineering experience, though the anonymized listing means some diligence is still needed.

top_offers.title: Late Co-Founder & CTO – Aviation Systems and Optical Sensing Technology
top_offers.why: A Geneva-based founding CTO seat echoes the Alaya cofounder story directly, but it's hardware/optical-sensing and certification-heavy rather than the TypeScript/AI stack, and equity-only comp is a real risk at this lab-validation stage.

top_offers.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, AI
top_offers.why: Well-funded early-stage AI startup with agentic and knowledge-graph work that lines up with the AI-augmented engineering focus, but it's SF hybrid/remote, a weaker location fit, and IC-level rather than a leadership seat.

top_offers.title: GPU Engineer (LLM inference engine)
top_offers.location: Paris, France / Remote within Europe-compatible timezone (1 week/month onsite Paris)
top_offers.why: Fast-moving LLM inference infra startup with real AI depth, but the role centers on low-level CUDA/kernel work rather than the platform and full-stack architecture background, and it's an IC specialist seat, not a leadership one.

top_offers.title: ML Platform Engineer
top_offers.why: Foxglove is a strong AI/robotics infrastructure product company, but the role is onsite-first in San Francisco with remote only "considered," a weak location fit, and it's platform ownership rather than founding-level scope.
